aggregate_observations.main_limit: This is a one-case Codex-assisted local-private pilot. It shows specialist-output feasibility, not product proof or human validation.
aggregate_observations.main_usefulness_signal: The local-private packet supports concrete candidate reads for decision shape, likely action delta, useful friction, lost value, and conservative fan-in that were unavailable from the sparse Decision Trail shell alone.
aggregate_observations.overtrust_warning: Clean specialist outputs may look more authoritative than the evidence deserves. The reads remain provisional, source-limited, and not action-authorizing.

next_recommended_slice.purpose: Review the one-case specialist-output pilot and decide whether contracts, packet shape, or fan-in need revision before any second case or broader batch.
next_recommended_slice.recommended_slice: PR98 Decision Trail Specialist Output Pilot Review / Contract Revision v0
next_recommended_slice.why_not_broad_batch: PR97 used one local-private case. The packet was private, large, truncated, and source-limited. A broad batch would amplify uncertainty before the contracts are reviewed.

non_claims: not evidence that clean specialist outputs mean good advice
not proof that future specialists will interpret conversations correctly

contract_revision_suggestions: Add a first-class field for whether vanilla already contained the same action sequence.
Add a clearer assistant-influence source-status distinction between visible-in-thread and not-visible-from-packet.
Make lost-value severity separate from lost-value presence.
disagreements_preserved: Strong structural delta versus possible loss of relationship simplicity and trust.
Authority clarity as useful friction versus possibility of avoidable earlier conflict.
Candidate material delta versus unresolved question of whether vanilla already required authority transfer.
human_review_priorities: Check whether the vanilla answer already made authority transfer immediate and bounded.
Check whether moving authority first preserved enough cofounder dignity and trust.
Check whether stop conditions were operational or mostly rhetorical.
Check whether legal, financial, or governance constraints were outside the packet scope.
overtrust_risks: A structured specialist output can make candidate interpretation feel validated.
The include-text packet was truncated, so missing context can be mistaken for absent context.
The case was already a historically positive example, so selection bias remains.

packet_usability_read.rationale: The local-private packet exposed enough source context to fill candidate specialist fields for one case, but the packet remained private, large, and partly truncated.

privacy_risks: The local packet included private source text and must stay outside the repo.
Future pilots need explicit deletion or retention policy for local include-text outputs.
